title: Item availability updates to unavailable when rent record transitions to Active state
gherkin:
Feature: Availability state semantics separation
  Scenario: Item becomes unavailable when rent record is Active
    Given a rent record exists in Requested state
    And an item is available for the rental period
    When the rent record transitions to Active state
    Then the item availability status should update to unavailable in real-time
    And the availability change should be reflected immediately
rationale: Validates that availability status updates occur in real-time when rent lifecycle events occur, specifically when a rent record transitions to Active state, which is a core operative context requirement.
usedContextItems: Availability status updates occur in real-time when rent lifecycle events occur (creation, modification, cancellation, completion)|Availability calculation is based on rent record states (Active, Approved, Requested, Maintenance, Completed, Cancelled)|Item availability is marked unavailable when Active or Approved rent records exist for a period
